description: MV-HarveyNET: A labelled image dataset from Hurricane Harvey for damage assessment of residential houses based on multi-view CNN is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arash Noshadravan, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). MV-HarveyNET is a visual dataset of segmented multiple views of the residential buildings damaged due to Hurricane Harvey. This dataset consists of images captured from 5 different views of 435 residential buildings located in Aransas County of Rockport, Texas. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-wzac-h261. Keywords: Post-disaster damage assessment, Visual dataset, Building damage, Multi-view CNN, UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) Imagery.. Published 2022-10-10. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
